gloss: swirling dust; dust cloud; sandy dust

definitions.gloss: swirling dust; cloud of fine sand or dust particles
definitions.explanation: Fine particles of sand or dust suspended or swirling in the air, typically raised by wind, vehicles, or activity on dry ground.

examples.japanese: {砂|すな}ぼこりが{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: Dust swirled up into the air.

examples.japanese: {工事現場|こうじげんば}の{近|ちか}くを{歩|ある}くと、{砂|すな}ぼこりがひどかった。
examples.english: Walking near the construction site, the dust was terrible.

examples.japanese: {強|つよ}い{風|かぜ}で{砂|すな}ぼこりが{立|た}ち{込|こ}め、{前|まえ}がよく{見|み}えなくなった。
examples.english: A strong wind raised a cloud of dust, making it hard to see ahead.

notes:
Combines {砂|すな} (sand) and ぼこり ({埃|ほこり}, dust). Refers specifically to airborne particles of sand or grit, as opposed to indoor household dust (ほこり/ちり).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {砂|すな}ぼこりが{舞|ま}い{上|あ}がる: dust swirls up
- {砂|すな}ぼこりが{立|た}つ: dust rises
- {砂|すな}ぼこりをあびる: to get covered in dust

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {埃|ほこり}: dust (general) — indoor dust, everyday grime
- {砂|すな}: sand — the material itself, not airborne
